scope: Independent read-only source/evidence diagnosis. No test or benchmark workload was executed. No source/test changes.

observed_failure.assertion: GOAL version 1 card after Preview plan, unchanged 5000ms expectation
observed_failure.page_state: Creating button disabled; no pending approval and no action error shown
observed_failure.api_log: Supervised run creation and controls GET completed; no completed plan-preview POST logged. Access log records completion, so absence does not prove the handler was never entered.
observed_failure.evidence_handling: Preserve raw failure and owned browser failure artifacts. The error context includes the ephemeral fixture operator token; do not copy that credential into public reports.

frontend_review.Governance.tsx: action sets busy, awaits postGovernance, catches rejection and refreshes controls, then clears busy in finally. Creating at assertion indicates unresolved POST or subsequent refresh, not by itself an incorrect state-rendering branch.
frontend_review.governanceApi.ts: POST supplies configured operator header, JSON, 15000ms AbortSignal timeout. An HTTP denial should reject and render an alert. Existing 5s assertion can fail before that transport timeout; increasing either timeout is not an accepted repair.

findings.confidence: Concrete source-level lock-order hazard; causation of attempt 6 unproven
mechanism: SnapshotProjectionService.get_snapshot locks the requested run for_update, then get_goal calls iter_capsules.
ApprovalService.ensure locks the requested run, then _validate_subject for GOAL calls get_goal.
FilesystemRunRepository.get_goal and FilesystemApprovalRepository.get call iter_capsules eagerly before inspecting any target cached aggregate.
iter_capsules loads every uncached unrelated capsule; load_capsule acquires each state lock and reads/recover files.
Concurrent snapshot(A) and snapshot/approval(B) can each hold their target state lock while attempting the other, creating an A/B cycle until 10s lock timeout.
findings.latency_consequence: Known target goal/request lookups also parse unrelated capsules unnecessarily; this can amplify UI latency and hold the target lock during unrelated work.
findings.recommended_diagnostic: Keep existing browser assertions/timeouts. Passively capture request start/end and thread stacks or lock/lookup boundaries. A tiny isolated run may pass yet fail to exercise cross-run snapshot contention; also correlate actual shared active/completed/repair fixture behavior.
findings.possible_repair_direction: Resolve run-bound goal and request identifiers within the already loaded owning capsule, avoiding cross-capsule scans while holding a target lock. Retain compatibility for genuinely unscoped lookup paths without weakening approval validation. Root determines implementation after reproduction.

qualification_disposition: Attempt 6 is a real failed gate, not clean convergence. No waiver and no replacement of raw evidence. Fresh complete rounds must follow any validated repair with revised source/input freeze if product changes.
